notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where every fish would appear in their shiny color
[/list]

notes.title: My Fishing Desktop on Linux and MacOS!
notes.content: [p]🎣 [b]Fishing Desktop is now on Linux and MacOS![/b] 🐧[/p][p]We’re excited to share that [i]My[/i] [i]Fishing Desktop[/i] now is available on Linux and MacOS.[/p][p]Just update from your Steam library, launch, and start fishing. 🌊🎣[/p][p]If you try it out on Linux or Mac, let us know how it feels, your feedback will help us polish things further.[/p]

notes.title: Small bug fix
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fix a visual bug where all fish caught would appear in their shiny color after catching 1 shiny fish
[/list]

notes.title: Vests update!
notes.content:
🎣 New Update to My Fishing Desktop!

Expand your fishing style with 9 brand-new vests:
🦋 Blue • 🌞 Yellow • 🌊 Aqua • 🔴 Red • 🌈 Rainbow • 💜 Purple • 🌸 Pink • 🌿 Green • 🪵 Brown

There’s also a brand-new achievement to unlock! 🎣

Plus, when you catch all fish, your shiny chance gets a massive boost, making it 4× easier to reel in those elusive shiny fish!

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where it would say that there are 67 total fish but only 66 fish would show up in the encyclopedia
[/list]

notes.title: Small changes #2
notes.content:
[b]Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*]The rod you have equiped is now visible on your player character
[*]Made it easier to understand you can view the shiny fish you have caught in the encyclopedia
[/list]

notes.title: Rod update
notes.content: [p]Hi fishers![/p][p]Get ready to catch even more fish with the fishing rod update! You can now speed up your fishing by buying rods in the menu. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Changes[/b]:[/p][list][*][p][b]Rods[/b]:[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Wooden rod[/p][/*][*][p]Copper rod[/p][/*][*][p]Steel rod[/p][/*][*][p]Golden rod[/p][/*][*][p]Ice rod[/p][/*][*][p]Fire rod[/p][/*][*][p]Magic rod[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Added a fish coin currency[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Some quality of life updates[/b]:[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p]You can see when you catch a new record (biggest catch) of a fish[/p][/*][*][p]Tried making it easier to understand what to do for the minigame by reducing the wait time of the start timer, since some people had trouble understanding it at first[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Two new achievements[/b]:[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Already hooked[/p][/*][*][p]Magician[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Fixed a bug where the xp needed for a new level would be to high[/b][/p][/*][/list]

notes.content:
[b]Chanches:[/b]

[list]
[*] Higher chance to catch shiny fish.
[*] Less xp needed to level up.
[/list]

notes.title: My Fishing Desktop release!
notes.content:
[p][b]My Fishing Desktop is officially releasing! [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45640145/ad2f29ad51ce2838c3321489428ac9a9aedc51a3.gif"][/img][/p][p]Step into a quiet world where fishing is more than just a game. It’s a way to relax.
You sit in a small boat, floating on calm water. Cast your line whenever you like. There are no goals and no pressure. Just you, the water, and the peaceful sound of your reel.[/p][p]Pick the background sounds you enjoy. Listen to soft rain, faraway thunder, forest birds, or gentle waves.[/p][p]Whether you want a short break or a quiet place to clear your mind, this is your calm space.[/p][p][/p][p]🎧 [b]Choose your ambience[/b]
🎣 [b]Fish at your own rhythm[/b]
🌊 [b]Relax[/b][/p][hr][/hr][p]💬 [b]We’d love your feedback![/b]
